## River Vaki (CR 7)

An elderly human-looking woman stands in the middle of the river, her feet resting on the surface of the water.  

**XP** 3,200  
NG Medium outsider (native, water)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., Perception +14  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +7 natural)  
**hp** 130 (10d10+30)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +6, **Will** +11  
**DR** 5/cold iron; **Immunities** bleed, mind-affecting effects, petrification, polymorph; **Resist** acid 10, electricity 10, fire 10; **SR** 15  
**Weaknesses** water dependent  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., swim 60 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +13 (1d6+2)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** animate water, water mastery  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (Cl 10th)  


At will—fog cloud, water walk (self only)  

3/day—dispel magic, quickened invisibility, water breathing  

1/day—commune with nature  


**SQ** magical mentor, water bond, water meld  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 16, **Con** 16, Int 14, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 19  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 25  
**Feats** Alertness, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Quicken Spell-like Ability (invisibility), Weapon Focus (slam)  
**Skills** Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Heal +9, Knowledge (arcana) +9, Knowledge (nature) +9, Knowledge (planes) +9, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Spellcraft +9, Stealth +13, Swim +12  
**Languages** Aquan, Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Animate Water (Sp)** A river vaki can animate water within 180 feet at will, controlling an amount up to the volume of a Medium creature. The water moves and acts as a single mass, appearing as a water elemental. It takes 1 full round for a mass of water to gather itself and rise up, after which it moves at a speed of 20 feet on land, swims with a speed of 90, and fights as a Medium water elemental (although it lacks the water elemental’s vortex and water mastery abilities). If the vaki that animated it terminates the animation, moves out of range, or is incapacitated, the watery mass immediately splashes to the ground wherever it is and returns to its normal state.  

**Magical Mentor (Su)** A river vaki can infuse mortals with bardic magic. As a full-round action, a river vaki can touch a creature and impart the magical spellcasting abilities of bards, causing the target creature to become a 1st level bard. River vaki only do this for aspiring bards who impress them with their talent. This gift is not freely given. The vaki may expect years of service in return.
